clips.caption: Four operations to keep from this section: <emphasis level="strong">addition</emphasis> changes the makeup of the waveform, <emphasis level="strong">scaling</emphasis> changes the <emphasis level="strong">amplitude</emphasis>, a time shift changes when it happens, reversal changes the sample order.
Before transforming, ask yourself: am I changing the height of each <emphasis level="strong">sample</emphasis>, or where it sits on the <emphasis level="strong">time axis</emphasis>?
The next section is one integrative exercise: combine two sine components into a single <emphasis level="strong">signal</emphasis>.
